definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese umbrella made of oiled washi paper stretched over a bamboo frame. Now mostly seen at temples, tea ceremonies, and in traditional or theatrical settings rather than in daily use.

examples.english: I walk through the rain holding a paper umbrella.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{唐傘|からかさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother treasures and uses an old paper umbrella.

examples.japanese: ⟦{茶会|ちゃかい}→茶会：14116_chakai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧{唐傘|からかさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}てられていた→立てる：01196_tateru⟧。
examples.english: At the tea gathering, a red paper umbrella had been set up in the garden.

notes:
A traditional umbrella of oiled paper over a bamboo frame. The name literally means "Tang (Chinese) umbrella," reflecting its origin, though it became a distinctly Japanese craft. Also written {傘|からかさ} and sometimes read からかさ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {唐傘|からかさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧さす: to hold up a paper umbrella
- ⟦{番傘|ばんがさ}→番傘：06295_bangasa⟧: a plain, sturdy oiled-paper umbrella (a type of {唐傘|からかさ})

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{和傘|わがさ}→和傘：15380_wagasa⟧: Japanese umbrella — the general term for traditional paper-and-bamboo umbrellas.
- ⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧: umbrella — the ordinary modern word, usually a Western-style umbrella.
